label: live-b
topic: List every exported function of .opencode/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/lib/deep-loop/write-containment.ts with a one-line purpose each, citing file:line.

questions.text: Which symbols does the module export, and how many of them are functions?
What is each exported function's purpose, at one line each, with a file:line anchor?
Is each stated purpose borne out by the implementation body and by a real caller?
questions.caveat: Four exports have no non-test caller outside the module; their purposes rest on the body plus unit tests.

findings.purpose: Drains and returns the module-level list of git calls that lost to a neighbour's .git/index.lock, so contention is reported exactly once per drain instead of vanishing into the fail-open empty result.
Maps a raw git status --porcelain XY code onto the violation-kind union (?? untracked, D deleted, A added, M modified, else other).

Captures the pre-dispatch baseline of every dirty path outside artifactDir (minus unattributable dirs/files), hashing each and optionally copying its bytes for a later faithful restore; returns [] when git, the worktree, or the scope cannot be reasoned about.
Computes post-dispatch violations as current out-of-scope dirty paths minus the pre-dispatch baseline, skipping unchanged hashes and throwing when artifactDir lies outside the worktree.

Writes the durable per-path record of what an out-of-scope write left behind under <artifactDir>/containment/quarantine/ (manifest.json, content/ bytes, patch-head/ and patch-baseline/ diffs) and never throws.

Applies the configured remedy without irreversible deletion: restore returns in-HEAD paths to HEAD or to captured baseline bytes, preserve (default) leaves the tree untouched, and not-in-HEAD paths are always preserved and only reported.
Builds the containment_violation JSONL event payload (violations, revert actions, patch path/error) and adds a dataLossPossible block naming paths lost to a HEAD rollback.

Runs the whole post-dispatch guard — detect, split regenerable vs guarded, capture the revert patch, quarantine, apply the remedy, partition violations from advisories — and appends the event when a stateLogPath is supplied.
Baseline capture bounds (2 MiB per file, 64 MiB per snapshot) plus a diagnostics bundle of eight private helpers exported for tests — none of the three is a function.

findings.statement: Only snapshotOutOfScopeDirtyPaths, enforceWriteContainment, drainGitContentionWarnings, and __internals.resolveGitToplevel have a non-test consumer, in fanout-run.cjs:2776.

ruledOut.approach: Feature-catalog corroboration of the export inventory
ruledOut.reason: The subsystem catalog document names none of the eight exported functions.
It is an exported object literal of private helpers, not a function declaration.
